paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) across five layer ranges for several configurations, with a horizontal baseline reference. The x-axis is labeled with categorical layer bins “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32” (treated as a linear categorical axis, spanning from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32). The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” on a linear scale, ranging from −15% to 5% with major tick labels shown at −15%, −10%, −5%, 0%, and 5%. A gray dashed horizontal line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” lies at 0% across all layer bins. The gold solid line with circular markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) is near 0% at Layer1-4, about −1% at Layer5-12, about 0% at Layer13-20, slightly below 0% (around −0.3%) at Layer21-28, and slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The light-blue solid line with circular markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at about 0% at Layer1-4, drops to around −2.5% at Layer5-12 and around −6% at Layer13-20, rises to around −3.8% at Layer21-28, and ends near −0.5% at Layer29-32. The red solid line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) is slightly above 0% (around +0.2%) at Layer1-4, moves to around −2.3% at Layer5-12, stays around −2.0% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and returns to about 0% at Layer29-32. The dark-blue solid line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins around −1.0% at Layer1-4, decreases to about −5.5% at Layer5-12 and about −14.7% at Layer13-20, then increases to around −11.0% at Layer21-28 and ends around −1.5% at Layer29-32.
